tasks.goal: Generate a lively night market in a Jiangnan water town during the Song Dynasty, with vendors trading with customers.
Generate a scene of astronauts repairing equipment in a space station.
Enhance the Song Dynasty night market image to ultra-clear.
Replace the space-station background with a Martian colony while preserving the astronauts repairing equipment.

Animate the Martian colony scene into a 2-second high-definition video of astronauts repairing equipment, with their actions playing in fast motion. Preserve the astronauts and Martian colony background.

assumptions: The qualitative ultra-clear image requirement is instantiated with the available 2x upscaler. Fast astronaut actions are preserved in the animation prompt; the source specifies no numeric playback multiplier.
